passing_checks: All 56 independent public regression, DIAG and negative-control commands have their expected results.
The actual production service passes all public deadline cases.
The retained replay inputs, SDK, compiler, image and six stage2 build artifacts match.
Twelve independent Disconnect event-order and stop-intent cases pass with ASan and UBSan.

new_failure.title: A no-handle stop loses its control command under transport refusal.
new_failure.cause: blec_command sets waiting only after acceptance. blec_stop treats waiting=0 and conn=0 as a completed stop after a refused Cancel or Scan Disable.
new_failure.cancel_consequence: A successful Create completion is discarded in OFF. The active controller handle is lost and no Disconnect reaches transport.
new_failure.scan_consequence: The host reports OFF without an accepted Scan Disable.
new_failure.reproduction: The independent public startup sequence and exact extracted production service reproduce the refused Cancel failure. The service also reproduces refused Scan Disable.
new_failure.classification: Inherited source defect in the required stop/cancel/backpressure scope. This is not a newly introduced regression.
new_failure.controls: Accepted Cancel and Scan Disable controls pass. Refusal assertions fail with return code -6. No sanitizer error precedes these assertions.
new_failure.disposition: Use one fresh stage2, then one fresh independent stage3. Do not advance this candidate to stage4.
requirements: Retain refused no-handle stop commands until acceptance or the original bounded cutoff.
Do not repeat accepted commands. Keep acceptance, status and completion distinct.
Preserve stop intent, late connection handles, unreturned credits and original Disconnect cutoff.
Use a truthful failed state when radio stop cannot be confirmed.
Preserve signaling, reconnect, queue bounds, identifiers, priority, fragments and normal MIDI.
new_failure.scan_failed_status: An accepted Scan Disable with Command Complete status 0x0c also enters OFF. The stop branch does not inspect the failed status.
new_failure.reproduction_commands: investigation/service-stop-record.json records 18 commands across three exact revisions.
